scope: SUMO simulation experiments only; this is not a CET signal plan or a real-world safety setting.

green.minimum_rule: min(decision_minimum_s, imported SUMO nominal green duration for that phase)
green.maximum_rule: fixed simulation cap shared by all pilot phases; extension remains an explicit agent action
green.provenance: FluxIA experiment guard selected to make early switch and extension actions testable while bounding each green; not calibrated against field data or CET plans.

downstream_blocking.single_full_sample_policy: hold only while waiting for a second fresh confirming observation; if confirmation data becomes stale, follow the imported SUMO program
downstream_blocking.forecast_only_policy: forecast risk never marks every destination blocked; if no destination is observed-open, release the lowest-risk observed destination after yellow and clearance rather than holding all-red on a forecast alone.

yellow.rule: inherit exact phase and duration from the imported SUMO program; the agent cannot alter or skip it

red_clearance.rule: inherit exact all-red phase and duration; it may be extended only when all destinations are confirmed blocked by fresh repeated observed measurements

limitations: The experiment profile enables the learning loop in simulation, but its green limits and storage threshold are uncalibrated hypotheses.
Per-controller CET safety-green, maximum-green, pedestrian and conflict settings remain unknown.
Storage capacity is currently an estimate, so a full observation is not a field-certified capacity value.
